title: Design system is a Road to live step: the Template Design System Readiness check runs per release version, must-fix rules hold Publish of a template not yet live (DESIGN_SYSTEM_NOT_READY), a live one only warns
steps: S2: Run node --test apps/tracy-web/test/road-to-live.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-readiness.test.mjs (the Postgres parts run when TEST_DATABASE_URL is set).
expect: S1: every test passes, including a release rebuilt from untokenized source failing CSS-1, a version past maxVersion failing SLOT-2, a nested EmDash fallback passing DEF-1, and a tokenizer swap that changes no byte counting no CSS-2 leftover.

S2: every test that runs passes: step design-system sits after customize, waits for the install file alone, ds-must-fix holds Publish with DESIGN_SYSTEM_NOT_READY, a published release only warns; rule-severity.json names every rule.
S3: every test passes, including the 'Design system · 5/7 passed' title, both groups and one prompt naming the tdsr skill and the local command.
evidence: Before this change nothing judged whether a release still declared the design-system slot: an untokenized rebuild, an unchecked version or bands kept whole were found by hand
fence: The road, the publish door and the local command read one check and one severity file; a published release is never taken off
